title: Odile and the Signal
author: Vesper Delacroix
blurb: Ada Underhill, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
